description:
-- updated on 2022-11-05 to address 30% rule --
-- updated on 2022-10-27 to address all comments. Timeline moved back due to the funding delays -- 
The Proposal is a continuation of a PoC of a BrowserWallet. Thus, we won't be demonstrating features which are already achieved in the PoC. The video is here (https://blocktrust.dev/IdentityWallet). In many aspects, it is a redesign and the milestones are mostly technical. While the outputs and the evidence are very specific, they are part of a major architectural overhaul, bringing the PoC on track to be production ready. 
(A) Migration to Manifest v3: The PoC was only able to run with Manifest v2. V3 brings major changes and we'll have to explore the technical limitations and redesign parts of the app. For our platform, there is nearly no documentation available, and this step might bring unforeseen problems. 
(B) The wallet will later be offering different features depending if the wallet is displayed as a pop-up or as a full-screen application. Establishing communication between the full-screen version of the app and the popup-version is necessary. 
(C) While re-architecting the wallet, we will also be implementing logging and an activity history to keep track of the actions the user took while using the wallet. 
(D) With Manifest v3 comes the possibility to keep service-workers alive for a longer time. We’ll explore this feature to determine if this can be used for us to handle long-running background tasks.
